notes: Summary: evaluating an on-prem, air-gapped code copilot to replace fragile internal LLM infra; primary goals = low-latency streaming in IDE + strict offline deployment.
Primary stakeholders: CTO (Anika Rao), VP Eng (Marco Silva), Security Director (Leah Brooks), Developer Tools lead (Samir Patel).

POC scope requested: VSCode/JetBrains extension integration + streaming token-level responses, model pinning per-team, hot-switch fallback to local quantized variant, no outbound calls allowed during normal ops.

Hardware ask (initial): bench target = 200 concurrent dev sessions with avg 40 token/second throughput; Redwood suggested baseline: 2x H100 80GB (inference pool) + 1x NVMe cache node (4TB) for prefix/KV caching. Verdant asked alternate A100 80GB config if H100 unavailable.

Packaging/installation requirements: deliverable = air-gap bundle (rpm/deb and container images) + offline upgrade script; signed artifacts with checksum; ability to install via secure jump host; documented UAT for security team.

Offline update flow: USB/OVF import of model/artifact tarball, ability to apply patches without internet; retention policy must allow purging token-level logs; cryptographic verification using customer HSM.

Latency SLA: aiming for 50-80ms token-to-token streaming in IDE for first-byte; acceptable degradation to 120ms under CPU fallback. Cost sensitivity moderate, willing to commit to reserved capacity if latency/SLAs met.
Quote from CTO: "No external egress during dev sessions — if your service requires callbacks to hosted API we need an exception process."
Security: SOC2 expected from Redwood, plus ISO27001 preferred; identity via existing SAML IdP; audit logs forwarded to their internal SIEM (Splunk) when allowed during POC in isolated mode.

Integration notes: require model-version pinning per workspace; ability to hot-swap quantized model variants for A/B rollout; VSCode extension should support incremental streaming and cursor-aware completions.

Risk/concerns captured: procurement timeline for GPUs (Q2), legal to approve offline telemetry (they want zero telemetry), internal firewall rules blocking container image pulls in air-gapped environment.
Stubs: security FAQ draft link (drive/verdant/security_faq.md), pricing deck stub (drive/verdant/pricing_private.pdf), threat model doc requested.
Action items assigned: Redwood to deliver proposed hw config and offline installer checklist by 2026-03-15; Verdant to provide non-prod lab access window and procurement ETA.
